pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: app/features/settings/billing/spend/SpendEngineFacts.tsx:173 The spend panel shows the Claude CLI as either 'available' or 'unavailable', based on a boolean that only says whether a `claude` file exists on PATH (app/_lib/engine-preflight.ts:51, existsSync). So a CLI that is installed but logged out, or blocked by the offline setting, still reads 'Claude CLI available'. That merges installed with authorized and shows an unknown authorization as a confident yes.

techniques.evidence: app/features/settings/billing/spend/SpendEngineFacts.tsx:173 engineState (line 144) has only two values, and its input is EngineAvailability.claudeCli, which is a PATH-existence scan. There is no authorized/unauthorized/unknown split and no offline veto. The technique names this collapse as its failure mode.
